video_title: "The Warriors Can't Fix This" — Nick Friedell

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama is the new face of the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Victor Wembanyama is the new face to me. He is the guy we have been looking for.
quotes.quote: The biggest thing is that Victor Wembanyama is the new face to me. He is the guy we have been looking for. Who is going to take over when LeBron James and Stephen Curry retire? Well, we found the guy. That is the guy. It is Wembanyama's league. He is the one that makes everything go now.

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' Game 4 collapse against the Knicks was historic
quotes.excerpt: When you go up 29 in the third quarter of a finals game, no planet should you win.
quotes.quote: It was the Spurs' collapse. When you go up 29 in the third quarter of a finals game, on no planet should you be able to come all the way back and win that game. The Spurs had leads in every one of those games. That Game 4 collapse is something we are going to remember for a long, long time. As much as I want to give Jalen Brunson credit, the Spurs had every chance in the world to win the title and they didn't happen because they continued to make mistakes way too late down the stretch.

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors are entering the Kobe-era Lakers phase with Stephen Curry
quotes.excerpt: We are about to veer into the Kobe zone with Stephen Curry.
quotes.quote: We are about to veer into the Kobe zone with Stephen Curry. Every night you are going to watch him play, everybody is going to remember just how great he is when he is out there. But this is a team that is not built with him as the centerpiece right now with enough talent around him to really think they can do much beyond that.

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors should prioritize youth and athleticism over Jimmy Butler
quotes.excerpt: Let's get younger, let's get more athletic, let's get some guys in here that can shoot.
quotes.quote: If I am the Warriors, I am looking at the first rounder they have right now and all the other assets that they have in the organizational war chest and I am saying, hey, let's get younger, let's get more athletic, let's get some guys in here that can shoot and learn from Stephen Curry and let's try to continue to build moving forward. Jimmy Butler might still be able to help at the end of next year, but that is a hell of a long way off and he has a hell of a lot of rehab still to go.

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo's fit in Miami was a missed opportunity
quotes.excerpt: I have always thought that there was a fit in Miami.
quotes.quote: I have always thought that there was a fit in Miami. But if it was going to be Miami, it should have been Miami months ago. The only surprise to me as we try to filter what may be real as far as a Giannis Antetokounmpo deal goes is the surprise would be if he is still in Milwaukee at the start of next year.

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' potential salary sacrifice for a new team
quotes.excerpt: Is he going to handle at this stage of his unbelievable career taking that much less money?
quotes.quote: The question to me as you start to break down what is going to happen with LeBron James is, is he going to handle at this stage of his unbelievable career taking that much less money? Whether it is the Warriors or somewhere else, because I just don't see LeBron being able to command the type of salary that he would be due.

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaxon Kohler is a potential draft prospect for the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: The guy that makes sense on the surface is Jaxon Kohler from Michigan.
quotes.quote: The guy that makes sense on the surface is Jaxon Kohler from Michigan, who just won the title. He is a big man who can shoot it and who can play a little bit down low. But guys, he is going to be 24 when the season starts. He is not exactly the guy that you are going to bring in and he is going to keep getting better and better.

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' roster is not currently competitive
quotes.excerpt: This is not a very competitive looking team right now.
quotes.quote: I don't think much is going to change. I think we can talk about this all day long. What if Draymond Green doesn't come back and what happens with Jimmy Butler? Could he get moved in his salary? And we haven't even touched on Chris Paul yet, what happens with his extension? How does that potentially work out? Guys, this is not a very competitive looking team right now. Let's get real. Jimmy is hurt for at least probably half of next year. Who knows if Moses Moody is going to make it back next year? Stephen Curry is getting older and just missed two months because of a knee injury. This team on paper just is not very good.
